operations.description: Begins an export of your activity history. The activity will be exported to a zip archive containing a single file named activity.csv in the same format as you would be able to export from your account's activity view. It includes the following fields: Date, Email Address, Sender, Subject, Status, Tags, Opens, Clicks, Bounce Detail. If you have configured any custom metadata fields, they will be included in the exported data.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] exports activity json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] activity exports satus

operations.description: Returns information about an export job. If the export job's state is 'complete', the returned data will include a URL you can use to fetch the results. Every export job produces a zip archive, but the format of the archive is distinct for each job type. The api calls that initiate exports include more details about the output format for that job type.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] exports info json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] exports id info response

operations.description: Returns a list of your exports.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] exports list json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] exports key list response

operations.description: Begins an export of your rejection blacklist. The blacklist will be exported to a zip archive containing a single file named rejects.csv that includes the following fields: email, reason, detail, created_at, expires_at, last_event_at, expires_at.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] exports rejects json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] email exports notify satus

operations.description: Begins an export of your rejection whitelist. The whitelist will be exported to a zip archive containing a single file named whitelist.csv that includes the following fields: email, detail, created_at.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] exports whitelist json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] email exports notify satus

operations.description: Deletes a dedicated IP. This is permanent and cannot be undone.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] ips delete json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] delete ip ips response

During the warmup process, Mandrill will gradually increase the percentage of your mail that is sent over the warming-up IP, over a period of roughly 30 days. The rest of your mail will be sent over shared IPs or other dedicated IPs in the same pool.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] ips start warmup json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] info ip

operations.description: Get the list of custom metadata fields indexed for the account.

operations.description: Adds an email to your email rejection blacklist. Addresses that you add manually will never expire and there is no reputation penalty for removing them from your blacklist. Attempting to blacklist an address that has been whitelisted will have no effect.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] rejects add json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] add rejects response

operations.description: Deletes an email rejection. There is no limit to how many rejections you can remove from your blacklist, but keep in mind that each deletion has an affect on your reputation.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] rejects delete json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] delete rejects response

operations.description: Retrieves your email rejection blacklist. You can provide an email address to limit the results. Returns up to 1000 results. By default, entries that have expired are excluded from the results; set include_expired to true to include them.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] rejects list json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] list rejects response

operations.description: Adds a sender domain to your account. Sender domains are added automatically as you send, but you can use this call to add them ahead of time.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] senders add domain json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] domain info sender

operations.description: Checks the SPF and DKIM settings for a domain. If you haven't already added this domain to your account, it will be added automatically.

operations.description: Returns the sender domains that have been added to this account.

operations.description: Return more detailed information about a single sender, including aggregates of recent stats

operations.description: Return the senders that have tried to use this account.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] senders list json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] key senders

operations.description: Return the recent history (hourly stats for the last 30 days) for a sender
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME]  [PATH] senders time series json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] address sender series time

operations.description: Sends a verification email in order to verify ownership of a domain. Domain verification is an optional step to confirm ownership of a domain. Once a domain has been verified in a Mandrill account, other accounts may not have their messages signed by that domain unless they also verify the domain. This prevents other Mandrill accounts from sending mail signed by your domain.
